sources.summary: Shenzhen Bay Culture Square sits at the heart of Houhai, Nanshan District, Shenzhen — the innovation core and headquarters hub of the Greater Bay Area. On one side rises a dense cluster of skyscrapers; on the other, the site meets Shenzhen Talent Park, the open bay, and continuous stretches of mangrove wetlands, looking out toward Hong Kong.
